script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
       'line', IF(l.id IS NULL, NULL, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'sales_order_id', CAST(l.sales_order_id AS CHAR),
         'item_name', l.item_name, 'so_quantity', CAST(l.so_quantity AS CHAR), 'so_item_uom', CAST(l.so_item_uom AS CHAR),
         'delivered_qty', CAST(l.delivered_qty AS CHAR), 'line_status', l.line_status, 'is_deleted', l.is_deleted, 'line_index', l.line_index,
         'plant_id', CAST(l.plant_id AS CHAR))),
       'header', IF(s.id IS NULL, NULL, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'so_no', s.so_no, 'so_status', s.so_status,
         'organization_id', s.organization_id, 'customer_id', CAST(s.customer_name AS CHAR), 'customer_name', c.customer_com_name,
         'is_deleted', s.is_deleted))) AS j
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) d
  LEFT JOIN sales_order_axszx8cj_sub l ON l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.id = {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.line}}
  LEFT JOIN sales_order s ON s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND s.id = COALESCE(l.sales_order_id, {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.so}})
  LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND CAST(c.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = s.customer_name

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'no', h.stock_movement_no, 'status', h.item_assembly_status, 'item_id', h.item_id,
       'item_qty', CAST(h.item_qty AS CHAR), 'item_uom', CAST(h.item_uom AS CHAR), 'planned_output_qty', CAST(h.planned_output_qty AS CHAR),
       'mode', h.bom_consumption_mode, 'is_deleted', h.is_deleted, 'source_so_id', h.source_so_id, 'source_so_line_id', h.source_so_line_id) AS j
  FROM sm_item_assembly h
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
   AND h.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.org}}'
   AND h.source_so_line_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.line}}'
 ORDER BY h.id

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'material_name', i.material_name, 'based_uom', CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR),
       'table_uom_conversion', COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR), 'alt_qty', CAST(u.alt_qty AS CHAR),
         'base_qty', CAST(u.base_qty AS CHAR), 'base_uom_id', CAST(u.base_uom_id AS CHAR)))
           FROM item_mji552rc_sub u WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0), JSON_ARRAY())) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.id = {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.item}}
   AND i.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'line_index', l.line_index, 'item_name', l.item_name,
       'so_quantity', CAST(l.so_quantity AS CHAR), 'so_item_uom', CAST(l.so_item_uom AS CHAR), 'delivered_qty', CAST(l.delivered_qty AS CHAR),
       'line_status', l.line_status) AS j
  FROM sales_order_axszx8cj_sub l
 CROSS JOIN (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT x.sales_order_id FROM sales_order_axszx8cj_sub x WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.id = {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.line}}),
		{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.so}}) AS so) k
 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND l.sales_order_id = k.so
   AND l.is_deleted = 0
   AND l.item_name = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.item}}'
 ORDER BY l.id

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'no', h.stock_movement_no, 'status', h.item_assembly_status, 'item_id', h.item_id,
       'item_qty', CAST(h.item_qty AS CHAR), 'item_uom', CAST(h.item_uom AS CHAR), 'planned_output_qty', CAST(h.planned_output_qty AS CHAR),
       'mode', h.bom_consumption_mode, 'is_deleted', h.is_deleted, 'source_so_id', h.source_so_id, 'source_so_line_id', h.source_so_line_id) AS j
  FROM sm_item_assembly h
 CROSS JOIN (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT x.sales_order_id FROM sales_order_axszx8cj_sub x WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.id = {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.line}}),
		{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.so}}) AS so) k
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
   AND h.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.org}}'
   AND h.source_so_id = CAST(k.so AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_axszx8cj_sub l
                    WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sales_order_id = k.so AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND CAST(l.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = h.source_so_line_id)
 ORDER BY h.id

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('member', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blade_dept p
          WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.org}} > 0 AND (p.id = {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.org}} OR FIND_IN_SET('{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.org}}',
		p.ancestors) > 0)
            AND FIND_IN_SET(CAST(p.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci,
                  (SELECT COALESCE(u.dept_id, '') FROM blade_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.id = {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.uid}} LIMIT 1)) > 0)) AS j

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
       'line', JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'sales_order_id', CAST(l.sales_order_id AS CHAR), 'item_name', l.item_name,
         'so_quantity', CAST(l.so_quantity AS CHAR), 'so_item_uom', CAST(l.so_item_uom AS CHAR), 'delivered_qty', CAST(l.delivered_qty AS CHAR),
         'line_status', l.line_status, 'is_deleted', l.is_deleted, 'line_index', l.line_index, 'plant_id', CAST(l.plant_id AS CHAR)),
       'header', JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'so_no', s.so_no, 'so_status', s.so_status, 'organization_id', s.organization_id,
         'customer_id', CAST(s.customer_name AS CHAR), 'customer_name', c.customer_com_name, 'is_deleted', s.is_deleted)) AS j
  FROM sales_order_axszx8cj_sub l
  JOIN sales_order s ON s.id = l.sales_order_id AND s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND s.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND CAST(c.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = s.customer_name
 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND l.is_deleted = 0
   AND l.item_name = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.item}}'
   AND s.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.org}}'
   AND s.so_status IN ('Issued', 'Processing')
   AND (l.line_status IS NULL OR l.line_status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled'))
 ORDER BY s.id DESC, l.id
 LIMIT 200
